name: Reuse Value 1 Choice
definition: Indication whether reused value is actual or estimated.

Actual.name: Actual
Actual.definition: Total value of the collateral reused when it can be defined at the transaction level.

Estimated.name: Estimated
Estimated.definition: In the case when the actual value of reused collateral is unknown or cannot be calculated, an estimate value of reuse at individual financial instrument level calculated.
